feedback: The candidate faithfully encodes the recurring task 'Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.' SEMANTICS: u0 is the idle/no-obligation state and u1 the pending-fix state; the persistent condition pot_boiling correctly drives u0->u1 (first boil at steps 30-90 guarantees the trigger fires every episode), and the event stove_fixed correctly discharges u1->u0. Since stove_fixed requires pot_boiling at the previous step, it can never fire while the RM is in u0, so no completion reward is obtainable outside a real boil; conversely, a boil can only end via stove_fixed, so the RM cannot miss a discharge. Persisting boil labels and all irrelevant events (siren_ringing, switch_toggled, client_arrived, order_taken, food_prepared, order_served, food_fell, served_while_ringing, holding_food) are absorbed by the per-state else self-loops, which are present in both states; no reward accrues on the persistent u1 self-loop, avoiding per-step accumulation. COVERAGE/REGRESSION: every state has guard+else coverage, and the required regression u1->u0 on task completion is explicit, so the cycle supports the 5-8 boils per episode. STATES/FINAL: both states are reachable, the design is minimal for a cyclic trigger-response task, and FINAL_STATES is nonempty, declares u0, and u0 is the accepting 'all obligations discharged' state (also the initial state), which is the right accepting choice for a recurring task. REWARD SAFETY: 0.1 on boil onset plus 1.0 on fix is dense progress marking bounded at <=1.1 per cycle; neither reward is farmable (the agent cannot start a boil, and stove_fixed is impossible without a prior boil), and doing nothing earns nothing from the RM while the environment's own boil fines keep pressure on. The empty-hands restriction on stove_fixed is enforced by the environment, so omitting holding_food from the guards keeps the RM compact without losing fidelity. FORMAT: matches the required REWARD_MACHINE header layout (STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION with else guards, REWARD_FUNCTION triples with source, guard, target), with unspecified transitions defaulting to reward 0. Minor non-blocking note: the 0.1 onset reward is for an event the agent cannot influence, but as a small bounded progress cue it is acceptable; if the boil is still ongoing at step 600 the RM correctly remains in u1 (obligation unmet).
